aiNote.text:
WAIT verdict isliye hai kyunki 5m (bull 21, bear 4), 15m (21/6) aur 4H (22/3) BUY hain, jabki 1m (9/11), 30m (18/2), 1H (19/4), Daily (7/15), Weekly (7/16) aur Monthly (13/9) WAIT hain; koi SELL timeframe nahi; weighted score abhi 4 hai (max 13).
Top bull checks: EMA Cross, SMA200 Trend, Supertrend, Ichimoku Cloud; top bear checks: MACD, Parabolic SAR, RSI, CCI; nearest key level R1 4115.7 hai, price abhi 1.1 niche hai.
Agar price R1 4115.7 ko breach karke R2 4156.5 tak jaaye to score 6–7 tak upar ja sakta hai, BUY shift possible; agar price Pivot 4075.4 ya S1 4034.6 niche gira to score 2–3 tak gir sakta hai, SELL ki sambhavna barh jayegi.
